title: ** Austin Officials Accept Odd Fellows Lodge Reception
summary:
• **Main Decision:** The city council unanimously accepted an invitation to attend a reception for the Grand Lodge of the Independent Order of Odd Fellows (a fraternal organization), with officials planning to meet at Congress Avenue and Bois d'Arc Streets at 12:30 PM.

• **Attendance:** Eight aldermen were present for the brief called meeting, with Alderman Crow excused due to illness.

• **Purpose:** This was a special meeting convened solely to decide whether Austin's city leaders would participate in welcoming the state-level Odd Fellows organization to the city.
transcript:
626
No pay
Called Meeting of City Council,
Austin, Texas, Feby 3d 1879.
Mayor De Gres presiding.
Roll called. [illegible] Present,
Aldermen Crow, Brooker, Millett, Platt,
Fann, Sheehan, Strong & Vaughan.
Quorum Present.
His Honor the Mayor stated the object
of the meeting to be the consideration
of an invitation from the Independent
Order of Odd Fellows of the City of
Austin for the City Council to attend
and participate in the reception of the
Grand Lodge I. O. O. F. of the State of
Texas.
Alderman Fann moved that the
invitation be accepted. Carried.
On motion Alderman Crow was excused
on account of sickness.
On motion the council adjourned with
the understanding that the members
thereof should meet at the corner of
Congress Avenue and Bois d'Arc Sts.
at 12:30 P.M in order to attend the
reception.
Approved March 3d 1879
L. M. Bradley
City Clerk
